evals.prompt: Write a tech spec for adding real-time price updates to our watchlist (web and mobile web). Today prices refresh every 30 s by polling.
evals.expected_output: A design doc comparing at least WebSocket, Server-Sent Events and faster polling, with a chosen design, message contract with error and reconnect handling, throttling of UI updates and accessible announcements (no live region spam), performance budgets, security (auth on the socket), rollout with a flag and fallback to polling, observability and open questions.
assertions: At least two alternatives are compared
Reconnect and error handling are specified
Accessibility of live updates is addressed
A rollback or fallback path exists
